answer: A commit-reveal jury lottery can gate new identities: each applicant locks 40 POA, then 9 jurors drawn from a hash beacon vote on liveness over 3 rounds. An operator farming a sable herd of fakes sees the lock rise 1.5x per extra identity, so ten cost about 4,600 POA. Jurors who vote against the oasis of honest consensus lose their bond, and every sonnet of signed votes is published on-chain so anyone can replay the draw.
